title: Add controlled dataset adapters for fixed reports and financial statements
description: Close the 'never treat the 18 dynamic reports as complete coverage' gap by adapting the fixed reports and financial statements that have no Dynamic* controller: balance-sheet, income-statement, cash-flow (src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportService.Finance.cs) and ar-aging (src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ReportController.cs ArAging). Add reusable IReportConfigurationDatasetProvider adapters exposing a finite field whitelist (statement line name + amount, with truthful currency/unit semantics: these simplified statements aggregate by amount without cross-currency conversion, so the adapter must declare that limitation explicitly) and the existing report menu authorization rechecked per request fail-closed. Preview delegates to the existing GetBalanceSheetAsync/GetIncomeStatementAsync/GetCashFlowAsync/ArAging semantics via IReportService/IErpDbContext, never builds a new controller/designer/exporter, and never cross-currency merges. Add dataset key constants and register providers in the existing DependencyInjection. Add unit tests asserting catalog exposure and preview parity with the legacy fixed-report semantics (line names, totals, authorization, no cross-currency merge). The migration registry marks these entries dataset-ready so preset orchestration can materialize them as presets.
acceptance_criteria: Balance-sheet, income-statement, cash-flow, and ar-aging gain controlled dataset adapters with a finite authorized field whitelist and truthful currency/unit semantics matching the legacy fixed-report output, with dataset key constants added and providers registered in the existing catalog aggregation.

Each adapter's preview delegates to the existing fixed-report service semantics (GetBalanceSheetAsync/GetIncomeStatementAsync/GetCashFlowAsync/ArAging) and revalidates the existing report menu authorization per request fail-closed, never cross-currency merging and never introducing a new controller/designer/exporter.

Unit tests cover catalog exposure, preview parity with legacy fixed-report line names/totals, menu revocation, and currency semantics for all four datasets; the safe Release build and ERP.UnitTests pass without modifying existing report endpoints.
implementation_evidence: The fixed reports and financial statements are implemented but not reachable through the generic platform: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportService.Finance.cs:13-80 (GetBalanceSheetAsync/GetIncomeStatementAsync/GetCashFlowAsync simplified amount aggregation) and src/ERP.Api/Controllers/ReportController.cs:196-222 (BalanceSheet/ArAging endpoints) exist, and src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/reports.js:60-65 lists balance-sheet/income-statement/cash-flow as fixed REPORTS entries. src/ERP.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs:69-70 registers only sales-order and receivable dataset providers, and src/ERP.Application/DTOs/ReportConfigurationDtos.cs:87-88 defines no financial-statement dataset keys, so these fixed reports are entirely absent from the generic catalog — confirming the '18 dynamic reports are not complete coverage' gap.
